messages:
Priya K.: Quick sync — we need a small audit of the marketplace reference templates (Azure + GCP) before next week's partner call. goal: surface any TF module inconsistencies, missing docs, or CI gates. who can own the checklist?
Jasmeen S.: I can own the checklist for GCP templates. will scope an initial pass today.
Miguel R.: I can take Azure side. do we want to enforce module version pinning and a changelog convention?
Priya K.: yes to both. policy request: modules should pin provider versions, include a short CHANGELOG.md, and have an examples/ directory with a minimal deploy.
Anya D.: Also recommend adding a small linter + fmt check in each repo: `terraform fmt -check` and `tflint`. We've had subtle naming drift across partners.
Sam - Cloud Partner Eng: Agree. I can prep a tiny GitHub Actions template that runs `terraform init -backend=false && terraform validate && terraform fmt -check && tflint`. Want it minimal so partners can copy/paste.
Priya K.: Perfect. can you include an explicit step to verify module inputs have descriptions? that helps docs audits.
Sam - Cloud Partner Eng: Yep. I'll add a step that greps for `description =` in `variables.tf` as a stopgap until we have a real parser.
Jasmeen S.: For GCP modules: we should standardize the naming: `redwood/<product>-<component>-<cloud>` e.g. `redwood/refarch-vpc-gcp`. makes marketplace packaging easier.
Miguel R.: For Azure I suggest `redwood-<product>-<component>-azure` (dash vs slash difference to match our existing pipeline). we should document both patterns and map them in the publish script.
Priya K.: Good catch — canonicalize in the guide and add a migration note for older repos.
partner-ci-bot: Reminder: scheduled audit ticket created -> https://tickets.internal/PRT-4839 (assignee: unassigned).
Anya D.: Quick sample for the GH Actions workflow (feel free to copy):
```yaml
name: tf-checks
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Setup Terraform
        uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v1
      - name: Init
        run: terraform init -backend=false
      - name: Validate
        run: terraform validate -no-color || true
      - name: Fmt check
        run: terraform fmt -check
      - name: TFLint
        run: tflint || true
```
Jasmeen S.: I'll run the first pass and add results to the ticket by EOD. will tag owners in repos that fail checks.
Miguel R.: I'll start collecting `variables.tf` examples that are missing descriptions and open PRs where straightforward.
Priya K.: Thanks — next steps: Sam publishes the GH Actions template to the partner repo starter, Anya adds the mini-guideline doc (one pager), Jasmeen + Miguel run audit and list failures in PRT-4839. we'll review on Friday partner call. :thumbsup:
Sam - Cloud Partner Eng: On it. will create a `starter-actions.yml` PR in `marketplace-starter` and paste link here when ready.
partner-ci-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-starter/pull/142 — checks will run automatically.
Priya K.: Excellent. if anyone hits blockers (partner access, secrets, or permissions), ping me and I'll escalate.
Jasmeen S.: thanks all — starting now.
Miguel R.: thanks
Anya D.: thanks :rocket:
